<thought>We need to find the template that matches the Still‑Gennari HWE reaction. The forward reaction forms a C‑C double bond and a carboxylic ester, so we search the template catalog for templates that form these functional groups. No specific broken functional‑group name for the phosphonate is available, so we omit that filter.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO",
    "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bonds", "carboxylic esters"],
    "functional_groups_broken": null,
    "bonds_formed": null,
    "bonds_broken": null,
    "bonds_order_changed": null,
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
